title: The muzzle lights the scene for one tick (64 px/m)
note: MuzzlePop (3464242): a shot near the camera throws a stepped 3-band pool of paper light, 5 m, for exactly one sim tick, over the ground, the print and the bodies. Photosensitivity: at most 1 per 20 ticks AND inside the kill beat's shared flash budget (~1 a second in a riot); none under reduced motion. Before = the same frozen tick with the pop hidden.
